question: In December 2020, the Chief Minister of _______ announced that India's biggest hockey stadium is being set up in the state.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

__
 
• **In December 2020, the Chief Minister of Odisha announced that India's biggest hockey stadium is being set up in the state**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chief Minister of Odisha Shri Naveen Patnaik announced a new world-class hockey stadium in Biju Patnaik University of Technology campus, Rourkela city
 
• It would be the biggest stadium of Hockey in India with a sitting capacity of 20 thousand.
 
• **Other stadiums in Odisha**: Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium(20,000 capacity), Rourkela and Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneshwar.
 
• These two stadiums will be the host venues for Men's Hockey World Cup 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• National Hockey Stadium, Lahore, Pakistan is the world's biggest stadium(45,000 capacity).
 
• Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium(20,000 capacity) is expected to open in July 2022 in India's biggest Hockey Stadium.
